name: Voice (any page)
description: The @yourco/voice widget injected onto any page: click the bubble and talk. Binds to a page's manifest when it serves one.
//: v1 runs the widget in the page (content script), so the mic prompt comes from the user's click. host_permissions covers the cross-origin relay mint + the app's own API. The background/offscreen cross-tab path (DIRECTIONS §1) is kept in src/ but not loaded here.
